machine: Brother Innov-is NV880E, small hoop (100 x 100 mm)
thread: New Brothread embroidery thread (Amazon.de), Brother colour codes; White is 1618 (not 001)
scan: Epson L3150 flatbed, Epson Scan 2 Photo Mode, automatic corrections off, 600 dpi, PNG, a white paper strip as reference
method: Each swatch's central 6 x 6 mm averaged and white-balanced on the paper strip (raw paper #f7f6f7); coverage = how far the swatch's luminance moved from the fabric's towards black at 6 rows/mm

swatches.note: Sewn with the default fill settings (4.5 rows/mm, under sewing on, default angle), not the 6.0 rows/mm intended (#297).

notes: On white fabric the White thread (1618) is measurable; Black, Red and Blue match round 1 on pink fabric within a few levels (they cover the fabric), Yellow and Leaf Green are truer on white.
The 1.0 rows/mm ramp swatch has a stray blue thread over part of it.
Stippling and the flexible spiral (fixed in alpha.11) sewed without stitching in place; the machine checks, shapes and the sunset patch sewed whole.
The T1 mark sewed as fill (3.0 rows/mm), not satin lettering, because of the same kit error (#297); that is why it looks messy.
corrections: 2026-11-04: Red, Blue, Yellow and Leaf Green relabelled by the densities actually sewn: the kit applied each swatch the next one's settings after the T1 mark (#297). White, Black and the coverage ramp were right.
